name: get_timeline
title: Get Timeline
description: Return the current local project session timeline.

name: list_tracks
title: List Tracks
description: Return the current local project session tracks.

name: get_media
title: Get Media
description: Return the current local project session media library.

name: collect_clips_in_range
title: Collect Clips In Range
description: Return stable clip IDs that overlap a timeline range, optionally including linked embedded A/V companions.

name: get_project_session_status
title: Get Project Session Status
description: Return the current project session revision, updated timestamp, undo/redo depth, and the most recent activity entries (edits made by agents and the editor).

name: inspect_timeline
title: Inspect Timeline
description: Return an agent-readable inspection summary for the current local project session.

name: validate_timeline
title: Validate Timeline
description: Return validation errors and warnings for the current local project session.

name: plan_silence_removal
title: Plan Silence Removal
description: Build and dry-run an avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 from externally detected silence ranges for the host agent (Codex or Claude Code) or other plugins. Returns the complete inline plan, stable planHash, projected operation results, and validation without analyzing audio, mutating the project, or writing files. Ranges are converted to descending extract_range operations so source timeline coordinates remain stable.

planId.description: Stable id for the generated avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 plan.

id.description: Stable producer plugin or host agent (Codex or Claude Code) workflow id.

jobId.description: Optional upstream job id for provenance.

silenceRanges.description: Externally detected silence ranges in the current pre-plan timeline coordinate space.

trackIds.description: Explicit tracks to ripple; linked A/V companions are included by default.

name: inspect_auto_edit_plan
title: Inspect Auto Edit Plan
description: Validate and dry-run an inline avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 from the host agent (Codex or Claude Code) or another plugin against its exact projectId and baseRevision. Returns a canonical SHA-256 planHash, per-operation tool outputs, projected timeline inspection, and validation without mutation.

planId.description: Stable plan id chosen by the producer.

id.description: Stable producer plugin or host agent (Codex or Claude Code) workflow id.

jobId.description: Optional upstream job id for provenance.

projectId.description: Exact AVS project id inspected by the producer.

baseRevision.description: Exact AVS session revision used to build this plan.

operationId.description: Stable unique operation id within this plan.

operations.description: Operations executed sequentially; each timestamp refers to the timeline state immediately before that operation.

plan.description: Inline versioned plan supplied by the host agent (Codex or Claude Code) or another plugin.

name: apply_auto_edit_plan
title: Apply Auto Edit Plan
description: Atomically apply the exact inspected avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 as one AVS project-session revision and one undo unit. A plan step may be any AVS timeline edit tool ({operationId, type: <tool name>, ...arguments}). Requires confirm: true, the exact expectedPlanHash, and expectedRevision; rejects stale projects, changed plans, invalid operations, and invalid projected timelines with structured errors.

planId.description: Stable plan id chosen by the producer.

id.description: Stable producer plugin or host agent (Codex or Claude Code) workflow id.

jobId.description: Optional upstream job id for provenance.

projectId.description: Exact AVS project id inspected by the producer.

baseRevision.description: Exact AVS session revision used to build this plan.

operationId.description: Stable unique operation id within this plan.

operations.description: Operations executed sequentially; each timestamp refers to the timeline state immediately before that operation.

plan.description: The exact plan previously returned by plan_silence_removal or inspect_auto_edit_plan.

expectedPlanHash.description: Exact SHA-256 returned by the inspection call.

expectedRevision.description: Exact current revision; must equal plan.target.baseRevision.

confirm.description: Must be true because the plan can remove or overwrite timeline material.

name: get_project_library_settings
title: Get Project Library Settings
description: Return the active local project library settings without leaking settings or session file paths.

name: get_project_io_status
title: Get Project I/O Status
description: Return the active Project I/O status, current settings, and current project summary.

name: list_recent_project_workspaces
title: List Recent Project Workspaces
description: Return recent Project I/O workspaces with reachability and project summaries, without leaking settings or session file paths.

name: forget_recent_project_workspace
title: Forget Recent Project Workspace
description: Forget one recent Project I/O workspace entry without deleting project data.

name: inspect_project_library_target
title: Inspect Project Library Target
description: Inspect a local project library target for agent-readable blockers before create or switch operations.

name: inspect_project_workspace_delete
title: Inspect Project Workspace Delete
description: Inspect whether a Project I/O workspace can be safely deleted and return the required confirmation data.

name: inspect_project_workspace_restore
title: Inspect Project Workspace Restore
description: Inspect whether a .deleted Project I/O workspace can be safely restored to its original non-active data directory.

name: create_project_session
title: Create Project Session
description: Create a new empty project-session.json in a Project Library target and make that library active.

name: switch_project_library
title: Switch Project Library
description: Switch the active Project Library to a target that already contains project-session.json.

name: delete_project_workspace
title: Delete Project Workspace
description: Safely delete a non-current Project I/O workspace by renaming its app-owned data directory to a reversible .deleted path.

name: restore_project_workspace
title: Restore Project Workspace
description: Restore a Project I/O workspace from its derived .deleted path without activating it.

name: set_project_library_settings
title: Set Project Library Settings
description: Set the local project data directory after validating the absolute filesystem path and revision.

name: reset_project_library_settings
title: Reset Project Library Settings
description: Reset the local project data directory to the default after validating the settings revision.

name: search_media
title: Search Media
description: Search the current local project session media library.

name: register_media
title: Register Media
description: Register an already-local or same-origin served media asset in the current local project session.

name: import_media_file
title: Import Media File
description: Copy an absolute local media file into the active project library and register it in the current session.

name: import_media_file_to_timeline
title: Import Media File To Timeline
description: Copy an absolute local media file into the active project library, register it, and place it on the timeline. Set editMode to insert to fit gaps and push later clips right, or overwrite to replace overlapping timeline range.

name: import_handoff_manifest
title: Import Handoff Manifest
description: Import a local CodexVideo handoff manifest into the active AVS project session for requests like 動画を手動編集できる形に by copying local assets into the project library, ensuring tracks, placing clips/captions, and returning agent-readable ID mappings.

name: import_codexvideo_job
title: Import CodexVideo Job
description: Alias for import_handoff_manifest. Accepts a local CodexVideo avs.codexvideo-handoff.v1 manifest path and imports it into the active AVS project session.

name: delete_media
title: Delete Media
description: Delete an unused media asset from the current local project session media library.

name: add_clips
title: Add Clips
description: Add one or more clips to the current local project session timeline. Set editMode to insert to fit gaps and push later clips right, or overwrite to replace overlapping timeline range.

name: add_track
title: Add Track
description: Add an empty timeline track to the current local project session.

name: delete_clip
title: Delete Clip
description: Delete a clip from the current local project session timeline.

name: delete_clips
title: Delete Clips
description: Delete multiple clips in one operation, expanding linked embedded A/V companions once. Requires confirm: true.

name: lift_range
title: Lift Range
description: Remove material inside [startSeconds,endSeconds) from affected tracks while preserving the timeline gap. Linked embedded A/V companions are included atomically. Requires confirm: true.

name: extract_range
title: Extract Range
description: Remove material inside [startSeconds,endSeconds) from affected tracks and shift later affected clips left by the range duration. Linked embedded A/V companions are included atomically. Requires confirm: true.

name: ripple_delete_clip
title: Ripple Delete Clip
description: Delete a clip and close the resulting gap on its track, keeping linked embedded audio aligned.

name: close_gap_at_time
title: Close Gap At Time
description: Close the gap at a timeline time on a track and move later linked clips with the shifted clips.

name: delete_track
title: Delete Track
description: Delete a timeline track. Non-empty tracks require deleteClips: true to remove their timeline clips too.

name: reorder_track
title: Reorder Track
description: Move an existing timeline track before or after another track of the same kind.

name: move_clip
title: Move Clip
description: Move a clip to a new track and/or start time. Set editMode to insert to fit cut gaps and push later clips right, or overwrite to clear the destination range without rippling. Accepts legacy startTime or startSeconds.

name: move_clips
title: Move Clips
description: Move multiple clips together by deltaSeconds (or so the earliest starts at startSeconds), keeping linked embedded A/V companions aligned. editMode insert opens room on each track; overwrite clears exactly the range each moved clip lands on.

name: trim_clip
title: Trim Clip
description: Trim a clip using timeline start, end, duration, and/or source start seconds.

name: ripple_trim_clip
title: Ripple Trim Clip
description: Trim a clip edge at a timeline time and shift downstream clips from the old clip end, keeping linked embedded A/V companions synchronized.

name: slip_clip
title: Slip Clip
description: Shift a temporal media clip's source window without changing its timeline start or duration. Linked embedded A/V companions are updated atomically.

name: slide_clip
title: Slide Clip
description: Move one clip between exact adjacent neighbors while trimming those neighbors so the combined timeline span stays unchanged.

name: roll_edit
title: Roll Edit
description: Move the edit point between two exactly adjacent clips on the same track while preserving their combined timeline span.

name: trim_clip_to_time
title: Trim Clip To Time
description: Trim a clip start or end edge to an explicit playhead/timeline time.

name: trim_clips_to_time
title: Trim Clips To Time
description: Trim multiple explicit clips to a playhead/timeline time, expanding linked embedded A/V companions.

name: delete_left_at_time
title: Delete Left At Time
description: Delete the left side of a selected clip, or the clip on a selected track, up to a playhead/timeline time.

name: delete_clips_left_at_time
title: Delete Clips Left At Time
description: Delete the left side of multiple explicit clips to a playhead/timeline time. Requires confirm: true.

name: delete_right_at_time
title: Delete Right At Time
description: Delete the right side of a selected clip, or the clip on a selected track, from a playhead/timeline time.

name: delete_clips_right_at_time
title: Delete Clips Right At Time
description: Delete the right side of multiple explicit clips from a playhead/timeline time. Requires confirm: true.

name: split_clip
title: Split Clip
description: Split an existing clip at a timeline time.

name: blade_at_time
title: Blade At Time
description: Split every eligible clip at a playhead/timeline time on selected tracks or selected clips.

name: set_clip_properties
title: Set Clip Properties
description: Update editable properties on an existing clip.

name: set_clip_audio
title: Set Clip Audio
description: Update audio clip volume, mute, and fade settings.

name: set_track_muted
title: Set Track Muted
description: Toggle a timeline track ON/OFF in the current local project session.

name: undo_project
title: Undo Project
description: Undo the latest project edit from the shared local project session history.

name: redo_project
title: Redo Project
description: Redo the latest undone project edit from the shared local project session history.

name: set_caption_text
title: Set Caption Text
description: Update the text of a caption clip in the current local project session timeline.

name: add_captions
title: Add Captions
description: Add caption entries to the current local project session.

name: render_preview
title: Render Preview
description: Render the first durationSeconds (default 10) of the current AVS project session to a local .mp4 with the same composition as the final export, for AVSでpreview/export workflows. Default output: <library>/previews/preview.mp4.

name: render_final_export
title: Render Final Export
description: Render the whole current AVS project session to a local .mp4 and wait for it. Writes to a temporary file and replaces the output only on success. No uploads or provider calls. Default output: <library>/exports/final-export.mp4.

name: start_render_final_export
title: Start Render Final Export
description: Start a final export of the current AVS project session in the background and return its job. The job state is stored in the project library, so get_render_final_export_status and cancel_render_final_export work from any AVS process and from the editor. One export runs per library at a time. Output must be an .mp4 under the library exports/ or previews/ folder, or an imported CodexVideo job avs/exports or avs/previews folder.

name: get_render_final_export_status
title: Get Render Final Export Status
description: Return a final export job (state, progress 0-1, output path, error) by jobId, or the most recent job of the active library when jobId is omitted.

name: cancel_render_final_export
title: Cancel Render Final Export
description: Ask a running final export job to stop (by jobId, or the running job when omitted). An output file that existed before the export is left untouched.

name: set_project_settings
title: Set Project Settings
description: Change the project title, fps, resolution, sample rate, or project metadata keys (a null value removes a key) as one undoable revision.

name: set_track_properties
title: Set Track Properties
description: Rename a timeline track and/or lock or unlock it. A locked track refuses every clip edit with TRACK_LOCKED until it is unlocked.
